title: Applications of Mathematical Biology (TUM, Modul MA3602)
titleEn: Applications of Mathematical Biology (TUM, Module MA3602)
description: Upon successful completion of the module, students are able to read most articles from biomathematical journals, to perform a basic literature research and know the most important data bases to search for biomathematical papers. Finally, students are able to approach a given problem, know the standard models and adapt them to the problem under consideration. 9 ECTS, angeboten im Sommersemester, Version 2023s.
